title: Essential Redis Commands
subtitle: GET, SET, DEL, KEYS, SCAN, EXPIRE, and TTL

content.text: Every Redis value lives under a key. Key naming conventions (like user:1:profile) help organise data.

content.code:
# Key operations
SET greeting "Hello"
GET greeting
DEL greeting
EXISTS greeting  # 0

# Expiry
SET session:abc "data" EX 3600  # expires in 1 hour
TTL session:abc  # seconds remaining

# Pattern scan (use SCAN not KEYS in production)
SCAN 0 MATCH user:* COUNT 100

content.text: Never use KEYS * in production — it blocks the server. Use SCAN instead.

questions.question: What does TTL return when a key has no expiry?
questions.explanation: TTL returns -1 for keys that exist but have no expiry set.

faq.q: How do I rename a key?
faq.a: RENAME oldkey newkey. If newkey already exists it is overwritten.
